summary: The sell-off has deepened: the Sensex is down over 1,000 pts and the Nifty is off about 1.6%, with over ₹8 trillion of market value wiped out ahead of the long weekend.

detail.tone: Losses have widened further from 1:30 as rising oil adds to FII-led selling; there is no sign of dip-buying before the three-day break.
watch: Whether the Nifty holds the 22,222 support

top.title: Brent climbs back toward $100
top.line: Oil reverses its morning dip as West Asia tensions persist, hitting Indian equities
more: Brent was near $96.76 earlier in the day
Higher oil hurts India's import bill and the rupee
US-Iran talks on reopening Hormuz remain unresolved

top.title: Tata Motors PV sales rise 15% to 70,210
top.line: Tata PV beat the ~67,000 estimate; Q2 volumes jumped 40% to 2,01,723 units
more: Tata Motors PV shares fell 2.2% to ₹277.40
Strong numbers across carmakers have not stopped the auto rout

top.title: Auto, realty and FMCG lead the slump
top.line: Sector selling broadens beyond autos as the Sensex sinks more than 1,000 pts
more: Realty and FMCG have joined autos among the biggest decliners
Over ₹8 trillion of investor wealth has been wiped out
